name: Seychelles (1977–1996)
description: Two horizontal stripes of red over green separated by a white wavy stripe.
history: Adopted after the coup of June 1977 that brought France-Albert René to power, based on the flag of his Seychelles People's United Party, with a wavy white stripe for the ocean. It was replaced on 8 January 1996 by the present five-coloured flag after the return to multi-party politics.
